User.title: User
User.description: User account details, VIP membership access, current coin balance, and daily tasks watching progress.

email.description: The email address of the user.

isAdmin.description: Flag indicating if the user has database administrator access.

balance.description: Available coin balance of the user.

currentVIP.description: The active VIP level identifier of the user (e.g. 'plata', 'oro', 'rubi').

tasksCompletedToday.description: Number of videos watched today by the user.

lastTaskDate.description: The date when the user completed their last task (YYYY-MM-DD).

DepositRequest.title: DepositRequest
DepositRequest.description: A booking request submitted by a user to purchase/register a VIP tier with proof of payment.

Configuration.title: Configuration
Configuration.description: System variables for conversion rate, withdrawal fees, allowed calendar dates, and active VIP membership levels.

conversionRate.description: Multiplication factor representing how many Coins match 1 USD (defaults to 36.7).

viptiers.description: All configured active and inactive VIP memberships offered by tappmusic.

withdrawalConfig.description: Rules determining withdrawal commission fees and day restrictions.

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles which hold the admin credential, balance, and VIP levels to authorise console operations.

/deposit_requests/{requestId}.description: Financial deposit and VIP purchase requests submitted by users waiting for admin approval.

/configurations/{configId}.description: Consolidated system state holding the current active rates, withdrawal configs, and tiers list.
